name: uso-bateria
description: Clawd junto a una batería pixelada con tu uso semanal de Claude, en un mini panel de Claude Desktop

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: the small panel, or the window background where the app shows no panel. panel: always the small panel. fondo: always the background. Also /bateria-ajustes modo …

position.title: Position
position.description: On the background: where the card sits beside the chat column; the bottom spots sit level with the prompt box. /bateria-mover places it with a click

size.title: Size
size.description: How big the battery card is

style.title: Style
style.description: compact: one low strip; full: the original tall card

opacity.title: Card background
opacity.description: How solid the card's dark background is

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the card's text: es (Spanish) or en (English)

mobile.title: On the phone
mobile.description: Also show the card in the Claude mobile app (it sits behind the messages there)
